The panel, live

The real component, not a picture of one — the markup, CSS and behaviour below are lifted out of the product page at build time, so this page cannot drift from it. Hover the panel to open it. Everything works: the peek, the one-open-category rule, the sheen on the pill, and the preview on a dwell over Context Studio.

One override applies on this page and nowhere else: the panel and the preview are position: absolute so they can sit inside the box above. In the product both are fixed to the viewport.

Anatomy

Two variants of one component. Content width is the only real difference — 36px crunched against 208px opened — and every block sits at the same y in both, on a uniform 16px rhythm. Measured against the Figma frame; the numbers below are what the built panel actually renders.

Blockyheight
Header848
Marketplace + rule7248
Home13636
Build18824 + items
Context Studio+1624
Library+1624 + items
Evaluate / Monitor / Resources+16 each24
Widths
--rail-w: 68px and --rail-w-open: 240px. Padding is 8px 16px at both, so content is 36px or 208px.
One rule, two positions
Every row is justify-content: center with 8px padding. That puts the icon at x=10 in a 36px box and at x=8 once a label flexes beside it — the two positions the component specifies, without a width-conditional rule.
Item
36px tall, 16px icon, 8px gap, radius 8.
Group header
24px tall, 24px gradient tile, 6px gap, 16px chevron.
The divider
Zero height, stroke drawn above it. A 1px box adds a row and pushes everything below out of rhythm.
Active item
tonal-1 fill, card/selected border, coloured-blue label at 500. Padding drops to 7px so the border does not push the icon off the 8px line — Figma strokes sit inside the box.

What is in it

Every row, its glyph and where it sits. Groups collapse; leaves do not.

Rules

Each of these was a decision with a reason. Change them deliberately, not by accident.

Opens on hover
120ms in, 220ms out. The asymmetry stops a cursor crossing the panel from flashing it open, and stops an overshoot on the way back from shutting it. Focus opens it too — a panel reachable only by hover is not reachable by keyboard.
Overlays, never pushes
The panel is fixed and the shell holds a constant 68px gutter, so opening lays it over the page. A hover is not worth relaying out a page for, and content that shifts under the cursor is content you then have to find again.
One category open
Opening an item or a header collapses the rest, and the panel starts on the section holding the active item. Crunched this matters more, not less: the icons carry no grouping of their own, so every expanded category runs into the next.
Expansion outlives the width
Which category is open is independent of crunched/opened, so peeking and leaving never loses your place.
Empty groups are labels
A group with nothing under it keeps its chevron but does not toggle. No dead disclosures.
Offerings sold separately
Their own top-level row, never a slot inside another category — a top-level row is the only one the one-open rule can never hide. Off-plan it still shows, with a pill when opened and a dot on the tile when crunched.
Never grey out an upsell
The tile keeps full colour. Greying it reads "not for you", which is the opposite of the job.
Highlight where it will be seen
The panel is crunched by default, so any emphasis living in the label row is emphasis almost nobody sees. The dot is on the tile for that reason.
Motion is periodic, not constant
The pill's sheen crosses once every 3.4s with a long hold. Continuous motion in a nav panel nags. Reduced motion drops it.
Preview on a dwell
300ms to open, 240ms to close. Nobody clicks a thing they have not been sold; the offer should arrive while the eye is already on the row. The close is slow enough to cross into the preview and reach its buttons, and the panel is held open while it is up.

The preview clip

What plays inside the offer, at full size. Unlike the panel above, this is not built from this page's tokens — it is a separate, already-published piece (Cogentiq Context Intro), embedded whole rather than rebuilt component by component. That trade is explicit: it reads as finished in a way a token-driven build does not, and it can drift from this page, because it is not made of this page's parts.

Scatter
Around twenty app icons and UI fragments drift in across three blurred depth planes — the enterprise data a company already has, spread across tools with nothing connecting them.
Merge
Everything converges toward a single point off to the right as the camera pans there, and the sphere — the context layer — forms and powers up from what merged into it.
Chips
Six labelled chips (Glossary, Ontology, Data binding, Tool binding, Prompts, Policies) orbit the sphere and spiral into it — the categories, named this time rather than left as anonymous icons.
Reveal
The sphere blooms into a full-frame flash, the ground cuts from night to a light sky, and the piece closes on a lockup: Cogentiq Context — The Enterprise AI Context Layer.
How it is mounted
An <iframe srcdoc>, not an <img> or a linked page: the clip's markup, CSS and script travel inside this document as one JS string, so nothing extra loads at view time and nothing is fetched cross-origin. The same string mounts all three places it appears: this stage, the box in the offer, and the big view the offer's expand button opens.
Controls
Pause/Play stop and resume every animation in the embedded document via Animation.pause()/.play(); Replay cancels and restarts them, the same call the clip's own bottom-right replay button makes. There is no scrub bar here — the clip does not expose a single timeline the way the retired build's GSAP timeline did, only however many independent CSS animations happen to be running.
Reduced motion
Handled inside the embedded document itself, which collapses every animation to its end state under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce — not something this page adds on top.

Open questions

Decisions I made without a source, or left alone on purpose. Settle these first — they are the things most likely to change what you build.

Context, twice
Library still carries its own Context item from the Figma spec, alongside the new top-level Context Studio. If Context Studio replaces it, the Library row should go.
Re-opening when crunched
The crunched variant draws no control of its own. Hovering the panel is currently the whole affordance. There is no pin, so the panel cannot be held open.
The Context Studio glyph
Drawn to the sprite's 16px, 1.5-stroke language. The design system file has no Context Studio component, so this is not an export. Replace it when one exists.
Marketplace wash in dark
Figma names the pill's fill Gradient/blue but returns no value. Light is sampled from the component render; dark is derived. Replace if a dark variant gets drawn.
Groups with no children
Evaluate, Monitor and Resources are collapsed headers in every Figma variant. Their contents have not been designed.
Entitlement is a stub
A constant read off ?cs=owned. There is no real plan model, and only Context Studio is sold separately.

CSS
    /* ── Platform panel (left rail) ─────────────────────────────
       Two variants of one component: crunched at 68px and opened at
       240px. Content width is the only real difference — 36px vs 208px
       — so the same rules drive both and the labels simply appear. Each
       row is `justify-content: center` with 8px padding, which puts the
       icon at x=10 in a 36px box and at x=8 once a label flexes beside
       it: exactly the two positions the component specifies. ───────── */
    /* Fixed, and the page keeps a constant 68px gutter for it, so opening
       the panel lays it over the content instead of reflowing the whole
       page for a hover. Above the scrim so it stays reachable while the
       detail panel is open, below the Tiq bar. */
    .rail {
      position: fixed; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 80;
      width: var(--rail-w);
      background: var(--backgrounds-page-bg-1);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 16px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto;
      transition: width .26s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1), box-shadow .26s ease;
    }
    .rail.is-open { width: var(--rail-w-open); box-shadow: var(--shadow-rail); }
    .rail::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 0; }

    /* Labels are laid out at their real width the whole time and clipped
       by the rail; animating width instead would reflow every row. */
    .rail-lbl {
      flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0;
      overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
      text-align: left;
      font: 400 var(--fs-body-3)/var(--lh-body-3) var(--font-geist); letter-spacing: -0.56px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .rail:not(.is-open) .rail-lbl { display: none; }

    /* ── Header: logo, wordmark, collapse ── */
    .rail-head {
      flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 6px; padding: 8px 0;
    }
    .rail-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; }
    .rail:not(.is-open) .rail-brand { justify-content: center; }
    .rail-logo {
      position: relative; flex: none;
      width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 100px; overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--backgrounds-page-bg-2);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--strokes-icon-default);
    }
    .rail-wordmark {
      font: 500 18px/24px var(--font-geist); letter-spacing: -0.72px;
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }
    .rail-collapse {
      flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--strokes-icon-default);
      transition: color .15s ease;
    }
    .rail-collapse:hover { color: var(--text-primary); }
    .rail:not(.is-open) .rail-collapse { display: none; }

    .rail-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 12px; }

    /* ── Marketplace ── */
    .rail-market {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%; height: 36px; flex: none;
      border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-3);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
      padding: 0 12px;
    }
    .rail:not(.is-open) .rail-market { padding: 0; }
    /* Opened only: at 36px the art already fills the tile. */
    .rail.is-open .rail-market { background-image: var(--gradient-blue-wash); }
    .rail-market .bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    .rail-market .bg svg { position: absolute; }
    .rail-market .mark { position: relative; flex: none; width: 24px; height: 15.6px; }
    .rail-market .rail-lbl { position: relative; font-weight: 500; }
    /* Zero-height in the component, with the stroke drawn above it — a 1px
       box here would add a row and push everything below out of rhythm. */
    .rail-rule { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 0; flex: none; }
    .rail-rule::before {
      content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: -1px; height: 1px;
      background: var(--strokes-line-1);
    }

    /* ── Items ── */
    .rail-btn {
      width: 100%; height: 36px; flex: none;
      border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
      color: var(--strokes-icon-default);
      transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease;
    }
    .rail-btn > .ic { flex: none; }
    /* Hover draws a rectangle, not just a fill — at 68px the icons have
       no labels to hit-test against, so the row needs to say where it
       begins and ends. The border comes out of the padding exactly as it
       does on an active item, so nothing shifts by a pixel. */
    .rail-btn:hover {
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-4);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-card-default);
      padding: 7px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .rail-btn.is-active {
      background: var(--backgrounds-button-tonal-1);
      /* Figma strokes sit inside the box, so the padding absorbs the border
         and the icon stays on the same 8px line as every other item. */
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-card-selected);
      padding: 7px;
      color: var(--text-coloured-blue);
    }
    .rail-btn.is-active .rail-lbl { color: var(--text-coloured-blue); font-weight: 500; }
    .rail-stack { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }

    /* ── Group header ── */
    .rail-ghead {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%; height: 24px; flex: none;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px;
    }
    /* A category header is 24px of tile and label with no box of its own,
       and it is a control. The rectangle is drawn by a pseudo-element
       rather than by padding a fixed-height row, so it can overhang the
       24px without touching layout — and the children are lifted above
       it, since a positioned pseudo would otherwise paint over them. */
    .rail-ghead::before {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -6px -8px; z-index: 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      transition: background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease;
    }
    .rail-ghead:hover::before {
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-4);
      border-color: var(--strokes-card-default);
    }
    .rail-ghead > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    .rail-tile {
      flex: none;
      width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      color: var(--white);
    }
    .rail-ghead .rail-lbl { font-weight: 500; }
    .rail-chev {
      flex: none; color: var(--text-teritiary);
      transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1);
    }
    .rail-ghead[aria-expanded="true"] .rail-chev { transform: rotate(180deg); }
    .rail:not(.is-open) .rail-chev { display: none; }
    /* Collapsing a group hides its items at either width — the crunched
       panel shows a collapsed group as its tile alone, same as opened. */
    .rail-ghead[aria-expanded="false"] + .rail-stack { display: none; }

    /* ── Context Studio: a category with no children ─────────────
       It sits at category level rather than inside Library because it is
       an offering in its own right — and because a top-level row is the
       only one the one-open-category rule can never hide. Every Build or
       Library child collapses away; this one is always on screen, which
       is what a separate offering needs. */
    .rail-ghead--leaf { position: relative; }
    .rail-tile-wrap { position: relative; flex: none; display: flex; }

    /* Locked, the tile stays full colour. A greyed-out tile reads "not for
       you"; the point here is the opposite. The dot does the work instead
       — and it has to, because the panel is crunched by default, where a
       label-row pill would never be seen. */
    .rail-dot {
      display: none;
      position: absolute; top: -2px; right: -2px;
      width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--text-coloured-blue);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--backgrounds-page-bg-1);
    }
    /* The pill carries the Context tile's own gradient rather than the
       generic blue badge, so the row's two coloured things read as one
       offering instead of two unrelated accents. The gradient is static
       here even though the tile's turns: two rotations six pixels apart
       is noise, and the pill already has its own motion in the sheen
       below. No border — a stroke on a saturated fill only muddies it,
       and dropping it buys the 1px back as padding. */
    .rail-flag {
      display: none;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
      flex: none; height: 18px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 9px;
      align-items: center;
      background-image: linear-gradient(42.56deg, var(--purple-400) 11.95%, var(--blue-500) 60.99%, var(--blue-600) 110.04%);
      color: var(--text-button-white);
      font: 500 11px/1 var(--font-geist); letter-spacing: -0.11px;
    }
    /* A glint that crosses the pill every few seconds, with a long hold
       between passes. Constant motion in a nav panel is nagging; one
       periodic pass reads as emphasis and then gets out of the way. */
    .rail-flag::after {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 32%, var(--flag-sheen) 50%, transparent 68%);
      transform: translateX(-100%);
      animation: railFlagSheen 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    @keyframes railFlagSheen {
      0%, 58% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
      100%    { transform: translateX(200%); }
    }

    .rail-group.is-locked .rail-dot { display: block; }
    .rail-group.is-locked .rail-flag { display: inline-flex; }
    .rail:not(.is-open) .rail-flag { display: none; }

    /* ── Where Context Studio sits ───────────────────────────────
       Still being chosen, so every candidate ships and the panel
       switches between them with data-cs. One row, one set of
       listeners, nothing to keep in sync.
         inline — A · in category order, between Build and Library
         after  — B · past the last category, under a rule
         footer — C · the same row, dropped to the foot of the panel
         card   — D · past the last category, boxed, with a one-liner
         open   — F · in category order, opened into its six blocks
       A reads Context Studio as a peer of the categories. B, C and D
       read it as an offering of its own — by rule, by position, by
       card. F stops arguing about the row altogether and shows what is
       inside it. (E, which sat it at the top beside Marketplace, was
       withdrawn; the letters are not re-used, so F stays F.) */
    .rail-rule--cs { display: none; }
    .rail[data-cs="after"] .rail-rule--cs,
    .rail[data-cs="footer"] .rail-rule--cs { display: block; }
    .rail[data-cs="after"] .rail-group[data-group="context-studio"],
    .rail[data-cs="footer"] .rail-group[data-group="context-studio"],
    .rail[data-cs="card"] .rail-group[data-group="context-studio"] { order: 1; }
    /* Spare height collects above the rule, so the row lands on the foot
       of the panel and the rule travels down with it. A short viewport
       has no spare height to give, and C becomes B rather than scroll. */
    .rail[data-cs="footer"] .rail-group[data-group="context-studio"] { margin-top: auto; }

    /* F · opened into its blocks. The chevron exists only where there is
       something to disclose: everywhere else Context Studio is a
       destination, and a chevron would promise a list that is not
       there. The list itself is built in script rather than hidden in
       the markup — see setCsBlocks. */
    .rail-chev--cs { display: none; }
    .rail.is-open[data-cs="open"] .rail-chev--cs { display: block; }

    /* D · a box instead of a rule. The same row in the same place as B,
       lifted onto the card fill the Marketplace pill already uses, with a
       line of copy under it. The box does the separating a rule would,
       and the line answers "what is it" before the click instead of
       after — at the cost of the panel's evenness, since it is then the
       only thing in the list that is not a row. */
    /* Opened only: crunched, the box has no line of copy to hold, and a
       36px card around a 24px tile read as a button that goes nowhere —
       so at 68px the row is a plain tile like every other category. */
    .rail.is-open[data-cs="card"] #ctxStudio {
      height: auto; flex-wrap: wrap; row-gap: 6px;
      /* card/bg-4 is the one fill that reads as a raised grey against the
         rail's ground in both themes: bg-3, which the Marketplace pill
         uses, goes white in light, and page/bg-3 all but vanishes in
         dark. In dark the two are the same value, so the rail still has
         one box colour. */
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-4);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-card-default);
      border-radius: 10px;
      /* 7 + the 1px border lands the tile on the same 8px line the items
         indent their icons to — Figma strokes sit inside the box, so the
         border comes out of the padding. */
      padding: 7px;
    }
    /* The line is the point of D, and it needs the label's width to
       read, so it goes when the labels do. */
    .rail-cs-note {
      display: none;
      flex: 0 0 100%; text-align: left;
      color: var(--text-teritiary);
      font: 400 11px/15px var(--font-geist); letter-spacing: -0.11px;
    }
    .rail.is-open[data-cs="card"] .rail-cs-note { display: block; }
    /* In D the box is already the rectangle, so the hover one would be a
       second border 7px inside the first. The box takes the hover
       instead. */
    .rail.is-open[data-cs="card"] #ctxStudio::before { content: none; }
    .rail.is-open[data-cs="card"] #ctxStudio:hover {
      border-color: var(--strokes-icon-default);
    }
    /* The dot's ring is the surface behind it, and in D that is the box. */
    .rail.is-open[data-cs="card"] .rail-dot { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--backgrounds-card-bg-4); }

    /* ── Upsell, anchored beside the panel like the Tiq bar ─────── */
    /* 520px: the preview inside is a full-size clip scaled to fit, so
       every extra pixel of card is a pixel of legible caption. The
       card's own type stays at token sizes — only the media grows,
       which is the part that was too small to read.
       The stack sets no gap of its own. A heading and the line it
       introduces want to sit closer together than either wants to sit
       to the media above or the buttons below, so each slot states its
       own space rather than sharing one rhythm. */
    .upsell {
      position: fixed; z-index: 95; width: 520px;
      display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 0;
      padding: 20px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
      border-radius: 16px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-tiq);
      opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-4px) scale(.98);
      transition: opacity .16s ease, transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
    }
    .upsell.is-open { display: flex; }
    .upsell.is-shown { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .upsell-media {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--backgrounds-page-bg-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }
    .upsell-play {
      width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }
    .upsell-media-note {
      position: absolute; left: 10px; bottom: 8px;
      color: var(--text-teritiary);
      font: 400 11px/1 var(--font-geist-mono);
    }
    /* ── Expand, and the big view it opens ─────────────────────── */
    /* Even at 520px the clip is running at about a third of the size it
       was composed for, and the labels inside it are the part that
       suffers. The button sits over the media's own top-right corner
       rather than in the card's chrome, because what it enlarges is the
       frame, not the offer. Its colours are literals, not tokens: the
       media behind it is the clip's own ink-night in both themes, so a
       token that flips with the theme would be wrong in one of them.
       Painted at all times, only quietened — a control that does not
       exist until the pointer finds it is one most people never find. */
    .upsell-expand {
      position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; z-index: 2;
      width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(10, 13, 24, .58);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
      color: #fff; opacity: .6;
      transition: opacity .14s ease, background .14s ease, transform .14s ease;
    }
    .upsell-media:hover .upsell-expand { opacity: 1; }
    .upsell-expand:hover { background: rgba(10, 13, 24, .86); transform: scale(1.06); }
    .upsell-expand:focus-visible {
      opacity: 1; outline: 2px solid var(--backgrounds-button-primary); outline-offset: 2px;
    }

    /* The big view is the same clip in a bigger box, not a second
       composition: the stage is as much 16:9 as the window will give
       it, and the scale-to-fit below does the rest. min() takes the
       height constraint as a width, so a short window shrinks the
       stage rather than cropping it. */
    .filmbox {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 200;
      display: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: 40px;
      background: rgba(8, 10, 18, .74);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px); backdrop-filter: blur(6px);
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity .18s ease;
    }
    .filmbox.is-open { display: flex; }
    .filmbox.is-shown { opacity: 1; }
    .filmbox-stage {
      position: relative;
      width: min(1280px, 100%, calc((100vh - 80px) * 16 / 9));
      aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg); overflow: hidden;
      background: #080c1a;
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
      box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(0, 0, 0, .55);
      transform: scale(.97);
      transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
    }
    .filmbox.is-shown .filmbox-stage { transform: none; }
    /* Same literals as the expand button, for the same reason. */
    .filmbox-close {
      position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; z-index: 2;
      width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 8px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      background: rgba(10, 13, 24, .58);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .18);
      color: #fff;
      transition: background .14s ease;
    }
    .filmbox-close:hover { background: rgba(10, 13, 24, .9); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .filmbox, .filmbox-stage { transition: none; }
    }
    .upsell-head {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 16px;            /* clear of the preview above it */
    }
    .upsell-head .rail-tile { flex: none; }
    .upsell-title { color: var(--text-primary); }
    /* Tight to its own heading: the two are one unit, and the space
       around them is what separates that unit from the rest. */
    .upsell-body { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--text-secondary); }
    .upsell-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; }
    /* A fixed 240px, not the width of the card. A primary button that
       stretches to whatever the container happens to be reads as a bar,
       and the wider the card gets the less it looks like a button. */
    .upsell-actions .btn-primary { flex: none; width: 240px; height: 32px; padding: 6px 12px; }
    /* "Learn more", not "Not now". The secondary action on an offer
       should still be a way forward — a dismissal earns nothing and
       the card already closes on its own when the pointer leaves. It
       goes somewhere outside the app, so it carries the external-link
       mark and opens in a new tab: a panel is a place people are
       working in, and a preview card is not worth losing that place
       over. */
    .upsell-learn {
      flex: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
      height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--text-teritiary); text-decoration: none;
      transition: background .14s ease, color .14s ease;
    }
    .upsell-learn:hover { background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-4); color: var(--text-primary); }
    .upsell-learn svg { flex: none; opacity: .75; }
    .upsell-learn:hover svg { opacity: 1; }

    .grad-blue   { background-image: linear-gradient(225.24deg, var(--blue-600) 8.84%, var(--blue-500) 54.42%, var(--blue-300) 100%); }
    .grad-purple { background-image: linear-gradient(225.24deg, var(--purple-600) 8.84%, var(--purple-500) 54.42%, var(--purple-300) 100%); }
    .grad-indigo { background-image: linear-gradient(225.24deg, var(--indigo-600) 8.84%, var(--indigo-500) 54.42%, var(--indigo-300) 100%); }
    .grad-orange { background-image: linear-gradient(225.24deg, var(--orange-800) 8.84%, var(--orange-600) 54.42%, var(--orange-300) 100%); }
    .grad-green  { background-image: linear-gradient(225.24deg, var(--green-600) 8.84%, var(--green-500) 54.42%, var(--green-300) 100%); }
    .grad-teal   { background-image: linear-gradient(225.24deg, var(--green-600) 8.84%, var(--green-500) 54.42%, var(--cyan-400) 100%); }
    /* Context's tile ships its own gradient in the component (2906:507591)
       rather than composing the shared ramp trio — kept verbatim. A
       background-position drift turned out unreadable at 24px: two of
       the three stops are close blues, so most positions along the
       gradient look the same colour and only a narrow band ever showed
       the purple. Rotating the whole gradient plane instead sweeps
       every stop through the tile on every lap, which is the same
       trick as spinning a background-gradient element — the paint is
       oversized (inset -50%, so it never uncovers a corner as it turns)
       and sits on a ::before under the icon, which stays upright.
       Hovering the row quickens the spin — the one hover-driven speed
       change in the panel, since it is also the one tile whose colour
       is the entire point of hovering it. Reduced motion holds it
       still either way. */
    .grad-context { position: relative; overflow: hidden; background-image: none; }
    .grad-context::before {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -50%;
      background-image: linear-gradient(42.56deg, var(--purple-400) 11.95%, var(--blue-500) 60.99%, var(--blue-600) 110.04%);
      animation: ctxGradSpin 6s linear infinite;
    }
    #ctxStudio:hover .grad-context::before,
    .upsell-head:hover .grad-context::before {
      animation-duration: 1.4s;
    }
    @keyframes ctxGradSpin {
      to { transform: rotate(360deg); }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .grad-context::before { animation: none; }
    }
    /* The glyph is a flex item, not a positioned one, and a flex item's
       implicit stacking tier does not reliably beat an absolutely
       positioned ::before with the same auto z-index — Chromium paints
       the spin on top of it. Lifted explicitly rather than left to that
       tie-break. */
    .grad-context > svg { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

    /* The clip is authored against a full-size viewport: its sphere is
       a fixed 340px, its chips sit at ±300px offsets, and its captions
       clamp to px minimums. Sized fluidly into a 288px box, all of that
       stays put while the frame shrinks around it — one enormous orb
       and a caption running off both edges. So the iframe is given the
       viewport the clip expects (1600×900) and the whole stage is
       scaled down to the mount instead. Both mounts are 16/9, as is
       1600×900, so one factor fits both axes and nothing is cropped. */
    #upsellFilm iframe, .filmbox-stage iframe {
      position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0;
      width: 1600px; height: 900px;
      transform-origin: 0 0;
      border: 0; display: block;
    }
    /* The offer's box carries the clip's own ink-night rather than this
       page's ground, so it does not flash the wrong colour for the
       instant before the iframe's first paint. */
    #upsellFilm.upsell-media { background: #080c1a; }


    /* ── First run · the tooltip ──────────────────────────────────
       The panel is crunched by default, so the only thing a new user
       ever sees of Context is a 24px tile with a dot on it. This is the
       one moment that tile gets a sentence. Unlike the review page's
       looping demo, here it appears once, waits to be read, and does
       not come back: a coach mark that returns is an interruption, not
       an introduction.
       Both sit above the rail's own z-index 80 — the panel would paint
       over them otherwise — and below the offer card's 95, because if
       the card is up the tooltip has already done its job. */
    .coach-ring {
      position: fixed; z-index: 88; width: 36px; height: 36px;
      border-radius: 11px; pointer-events: none;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--backgrounds-button-primary);
      opacity: 0; transition: opacity .3s ease;
    }
    .coach-ring::after {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 11px;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--backgrounds-button-primary);
      opacity: .45;
    }
    .coach-tip {
      position: fixed; z-index: 89; width: 320px;
      display: none; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
      padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-2);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-tiq);
      opacity: 0; transform: translateX(-8px);
      transition: opacity .22s ease, transform .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
    }
    .coach-tip.is-open { display: flex; }
    .coach-tip.is-shown { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .coach-ring.is-shown { opacity: 1; }
    .coach-arrow {
      position: absolute; z-index: 2; left: -5px; top: 50%; margin-top: -4.5px;
      width: 9px; height: 9px; rotate: 45deg;
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-2);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
    }
    .coach-tip .rail-tile { flex: none; }
    .coach-tip b {
      display: block; color: var(--text-primary);
      font: 500 var(--fs-body-3)/var(--lh-body-3) var(--font-geist);
      letter-spacing: -0.56px;
    }
    .coach-x {
      flex: none; width: 20px; height: 20px; margin: -2px -4px 0 auto;
      /* auto on the left, not a fixed gap after the text — pinned to the
         corner regardless of how long the line runs. */
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-teritiary);
      transition: background .14s ease, color .14s ease;
    }
    .coach-x:hover { background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-4); color: var(--text-primary); }
    /* A sheen crossing the card every few seconds, the same idiom as the
       Try pill's glint and for the same reason: a nav tooltip that
       shimmers continuously nags, one that passes and gets out of the way
       reads as emphasis. It is a moving background rather than a moving
       element, so it cannot paint outside the card and the arrow — which
       sticks out of it — is left alone; no overflow clipping needed. */
    .coach-tip::after {
      content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0;
      border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none;
      background-image: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 36%, var(--coach-sheen) 50%, transparent 64%);
      background-size: 200% 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-position: 150% 0;
      animation: coachSheen 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    /* The band is only inside the card between 100% and 0%; the rest of
       the travel parks it off one edge or the other. Sweeping 150% to
       -50% spends half the 2s of travel on screen, which is a pass you
       can watch rather than a flicker you catch by accident. */
    @keyframes coachSheen {
      0%, 38% { background-position: 150% 0; }
      100%    { background-position: -50% 0; }
    }
    /* The sheen is painted behind everything the card says. A flex item's
       implicit tier does not reliably beat a positioned ::after. */
    .coach-tip > *:not(.coach-arrow) { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
    /* The halo pulses only while the tooltip is up, and stops with it. */
    .coach-ring.is-shown::after { animation: coachHalo 2s ease-out infinite; }
    @keyframes coachHalo {
      0%        { transform: scale(1); opacity: .45; }
      70%, 100% { transform: scale(1.55); opacity: 0; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .coach-ring.is-shown::after,
      .coach-tip::after { animation: none; }
      .coach-tip { transition: none; }
    }

    .btn-primary {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px;
      padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-button-primary);
      color: var(--text-button-white);
      transition: background .15s ease;
    }
    .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--blue-700); }

    /* Scroll region */
    .model-scroll {
      flex: 1 1 auto; min-height: 0; overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 16px 24px 24px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-page-bg-4);
    }
    .model-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 10px; }
    .model-scroll::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--strokes-type-default); border: 3px solid transparent; background-clip: content-box; border-radius: 8px; }

    /* Filter row (Tags / Created by / All time + view toggle) */
    .filter-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; height: 32px; }
    .filter-left { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; }
    .filter-group { position: relative; }
    .dropdown {
      height: 32px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
      padding: 0 8px 0 12px; border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-5);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-line-3);
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .dropdown:hover { border-color: var(--strokes-line-1); }
    .dropdown .chev { color: var(--text-teritiary); }
    .dropdown.is-open { border-color: var(--strokes-checkbox-focus); }
    .dropdown .badge {
      display: none;
      min-width: 20px; height: 20px; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
      padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 8px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-badge-blue);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-colour-blue);
      color: var(--text-coloured-blue);
    }
    .dropdown.has-count .badge { display: flex; }
    .seg-view {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
      padding: 4px; border-radius: 10px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-page-bg-2);
    }
    .seg-view button {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: 4px; border-radius: 8px;
      color: var(--text-teritiary);
    }
    .seg-view button.is-active { background: var(--backgrounds-icon-blue-2); color: var(--text-coloured-blue); }

    /* Tags popover */
    .tag-pop {
      position: absolute; top: 36px; left: 0; z-index: 40; width: 277px;
      max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
      display: none; flex-direction: column;
      padding: 4px 0 8px;
      background: var(--backgrounds-card-bg-3);
      border: 1px solid var(--strokes-card-default);
      border-radius: 12px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-pop);
    }
    .tag-pop.is-open { display: flex; }
    .tag-pop-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 8px 12px; }
    .tag-pop-head .search-field { width: 180px; height: 32px; }
    .tag-pop-head .btn-tonal { height: 32px; }
Behaviour
const railEl = document.querySelector('.rail');

/* The panel opens on hover and lays itself over the page, so nothing
   reflows behind it — the page's 68px gutter is constant. The delays keep
   a cursor crossing the rail on its way somewhere else from flashing it
   open; opening is quicker than closing, so an accidental overshoot on
   the way back in does not shut it. */
function setRailOpen(on) {
  railEl.classList.toggle('is-open', on);
}

let railPeekTimer = null;
function railPeek(on) {
  clearTimeout(railPeekTimer);
  railPeekTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    /* The preview sits outside the panel, so reaching for its buttons reads
       as leaving. Hold the panel open while it is up. */
    if (!on && $('upsell').classList.contains('is-open')) return;
    setRailOpen(on);
  }, on ? 120 : 220);
}

railEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => railPeek(true));
railEl.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => railPeek(false));
/* Hover is not the only way in — tabbing into the panel opens it too. */
railEl.addEventListener('focusin', () => { clearTimeout(railPeekTimer); setRailOpen(true); });
railEl.addEventListener('focusout', e => {
  if (!railEl.contains(e.relatedTarget)) railPeek(false);
});
/* Dismisses the peek without having to move the pointer off the panel. */
$('railCollapse').addEventListener('click', () => {
  clearTimeout(railPeekTimer);
  setRailOpen(false);
});
/* One category open at a time. Opening an item — or a group header —
   collapses the rest, so the panel only ever shows the section you are
   working in. That matters more at 68px, not less: crunched, the icons
   carry no grouping of their own, so a short list is the only thing that
   stays readable. Pass null to collapse everything. */
function railExposeOnly(group) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.rail-group[data-group]').forEach(g => {
    /* A group with nothing under it is a label, not a disclosure. */
    if (!g.querySelector('.rail-stack')) return;
    g.querySelector('.rail-ghead').setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(g === group));
  });
}

document.querySelectorAll('.rail-ghead').forEach(h => {
  h.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const group = h.closest('.rail-group');
    if (!group.querySelector('.rail-stack')) return;
    railExposeOnly(h.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true' ? null : group);
  });
});

/* Named rather than inline: rows can be added after load (F builds
   Context Studio's blocks), and they need the same behaviour. */
function bindRailItem(b) {
  b.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.rail-btn.is-active').forEach(x => {
      x.classList.remove('is-active');
      x.removeAttribute('aria-current');
    });
    b.classList.add('is-active');
    b.setAttribute('aria-current', 'page');
    /* Home sits outside every category, so it collapses all of them. */
    railExposeOnly(b.closest('.rail-group'));
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.rail-btn').forEach(bindRailItem);

/* ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
   Entitlements. Context Studio is sold separately: on the plan it
   behaves like any other category; off it, it stays in the panel and
   carries the flag — hiding an offering nobody has bought is how it
   stays unbought. Override with ?cs=owned to preview the owned state.
   ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
const OWNS_CONTEXT_STUDIO = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('cs') === 'owned';
const ctxGroup = document.querySelector('.rail-group[data-group="context-studio"]');
ctxGroup.classList.toggle('is-locked', !OWNS_CONTEXT_STUDIO);
$('ctxStudio').title = OWNS_CONTEXT_STUDIO ? 'Context Studio' : 'Context Studio — not on your plan';

/* The card sits a little above the row it belongs to rather than level
   with it: anchored flush, a 416px card hangs a long way below a 24px
   row and reads as belonging to whatever is under it. */
const UPSELL_RISE = 28, UPSELL_GAP = 20;

function positionUpsell() {
  const bar = $('upsell');
  const row = $('ctxStudio').getBoundingClientRect();
  placeTiqBar(bar, railEl.getBoundingClientRect(),
              { top: row.top - UPSELL_RISE, left: row.left }, UPSELL_GAP);
}
function closeUpsell() {
  $('upsell').classList.remove('is-open', 'is-shown');
  /* Nothing to see, nothing running. */
  if (filmOffer) filmOffer.pause();
  /* The panel may have been held open for the preview, so release it — but
     only if the pointer has actually left the panel. Moving from this row
     to another one inside it must not collapse the whole thing. */
  if (!railEl.matches(':hover')) railPeek(false);
}
function openUpsell() {
  const el = $('upsell');
  el.classList.add('is-open');
  positionUpsell();
  /* Mounted here, not at boot: creating the iframe while .upsell was
     still display:none left its animations stuck at currentTime 0 even
     after cancel()+play() — a hidden iframe is never given a rendering
     opportunity to start ticking. The box is already visible by this
     line, so the clip is not made in the dark. From the top every time
     after that: the offer is most people's first frame. */
  if (!filmOffer) filmOffer = mountCinema($('upsellFilm'));
  else filmOffer.restart();
  requestAnimationFrame(() => el.classList.add('is-shown'));
}

/* The preview is a hover affair: it arrives while the eye is already on
   the row, rather than asking for a click on something the user has not
   been sold yet. Opening waits longer than closing, so running the cursor
   down the panel does not trigger it; closing waits long enough to cross
   the gap into the preview and reach the buttons. */
let upsellTimer = null;
function upsellHover(on) {
  clearTimeout(upsellTimer);
  upsellTimer = setTimeout(() => (on ? openUpsell() : closeUpsell()), on ? 300 : 240);
}
if (!OWNS_CONTEXT_STUDIO) {
  $('ctxStudio').addEventListener('mouseenter', () => upsellHover(true));
  $('ctxStudio').addEventListener('mouseleave', () => upsellHover(false));
  $('upsell').addEventListener('mouseenter', () => clearTimeout(upsellTimer));
  $('upsell').addEventListener('mouseleave', () => upsellHover(false));
}

/* ── The big view ───────────────────────────────────────────────
   A second mount rather than moving the card's iframe into the
   overlay: re-parenting an iframe reloads its document in every
   engine, so the clip would restart regardless — and this way the
   card keeps a clip of its own to come back to.
   Opening hands over rather than stacking: the card is dismissed, so
   there is no live preview sitting behind the backdrop running the
   same six seconds at a size nobody can see. */
let filmBig = null;
function filmBoxKeys(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeFilmBox(); }
function openFilmBox() {
  const box = $('filmBox');
  box.classList.add('is-open');
  if (!filmBig) filmBig = mountCinema($('filmBoxStage'));
  else { filmBig.fit(); filmBig.restart(); }
  requestAnimationFrame(() => box.classList.add('is-shown'));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', filmBoxKeys);
  $('filmBoxClose').focus();
}
function closeFilmBox() {
  const box = $('filmBox');
  box.classList.remove('is-shown');
  if (filmBig) filmBig.pause();
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', filmBoxKeys);
  /* Held open for the fade, then taken out of the layout — leaving a
     full-viewport overlay in flow would swallow every click under it. */
  setTimeout(() => box.classList.remove('is-open'), 200);
}
$('upsellExpand').addEventListener('click', e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  closeUpsell();               /* hand over, do not stack */
  openFilmBox();
});
$('filmBoxClose').addEventListener('click', closeFilmBox);
/* Only the backdrop itself, never a click that happened to bubble out
   of the stage. */
$('filmBox').addEventListener('click', e => {
  if (e.target === $('filmBox')) closeFilmBox();
});

$('ctxStudio').addEventListener('click', e => {
  e.stopPropagation();
  /* Opened into its blocks (F) the row is a disclosure like any other
     category, and the group handler above has already toggled it. The
     offer still arrives on the dwell, which is where it belongs. */
  if (ctxGroup.querySelector('.rail-stack')) return;
  if (!OWNS_CONTEXT_STUDIO) {
    /* Clicking should not fight the hover that is already opening it. */
    clearTimeout(upsellTimer);
    openUpsell();
    return;
  }
  /* Owned, it behaves like any other destination — and being its own
     category, opening it closes the rest. */
  document.querySelectorAll('.rail-btn.is-active').forEach(x => {
    x.classList.remove('is-active');
    x.removeAttribute('aria-current');
  });
  railExposeOnly(ctxGroup);
});
$('upsell').addEventListener('click', e => e.stopPropagation());
/* preventDefault only because the href is a placeholder — with a real
   destination this handler is just the close. */
$('upsellLearn').addEventListener('click', e => { e.preventDefault(); closeUpsell(); });
$('upsellGo').addEventListener('click', closeUpsell);
document.addEventListener('click', closeUpsell);
window.addEventListener('resize', positionUpsell);

/* Open on the section this page belongs to, whichever item is marked
   active — the panel should never need a click to show you where you are. */
const railActive = document.querySelector('.rail-btn.is-active');
railExposeOnly(railActive ? railActive.closest('.rail-group') : null);
Shared helper it depends on
/* Both Tiq bars sit beside the surface that owns them — the modal for the
   description writer, the detail panel for Ask Tiq — flipping to whichever
   side has room and clamping so the bar never leaves the viewport. `anchor`
   only sets where it starts vertically: the control the bar belongs to. */
function placeTiqBar(bar, owner, anchor, gap = 12) {
  if (!bar.classList.contains('is-open')) return;
  /* Docked, the bar is pinned by CSS; a stale inline left/top would fight it. */
  if (bar.classList.contains('is-docked')) { bar.style.left = bar.style.top = ''; return; }
  const edge = 12;
  const w = bar.offsetWidth, h = bar.offsetHeight;

  let left = owner.right + gap;
  if (left + w > window.innerWidth - edge) left = owner.left - w - gap;
  if (left < edge) left = Math.min(Math.max(edge, anchor.left), window.innerWidth - w - edge);

  let top = anchor.top;
  if (top + h > window.innerHeight - edge) top = window.innerHeight - edge - h;
  if (top < edge) top = edge;

  bar.style.left = `${Math.round(left)}px`;
  bar.style.top = `${Math.round(top)}px`;
}

/* Runs the gradient sweep across a bar's placeholder, once per bar for
   the life of the page — see .tb-ghost. Typing cuts it short, since a
   flourish that talks over the user is just in the way. */
const tiqShimmered = new Set();
function shimmerOnce(key, rowSel, ghostId, inputId) {
  if (tiqShimmered.has(key) || reducedMotion()) return;
  tiqShimmered.add(key);
  const row = document.querySelector(rowSel), ghost = $(ghostId), input = $(inputId);
  ghost.textContent = input.placeholder;
  row.classList.add('is-shimmer');
  const stop = () => row.classList.remove('is-shimmer');
  ghost.addEventListener('animationend', stop, { once: true });
  input.addEventListener('input', stop, { once: true });
}

/* ══ Context Studio · the preview clip ═══════════════════════════
   The whole piece travels in this page as one string and is mounted
   into an iframe, so nothing is fetched when the offer opens. */

  :root{
    --ink-night:#080c1a;
    --cobalt:#2f6bf0;
    --white:#ffffff;
    --cap-dark:rgba(236,240,255,.92);
    --hub-x:90vw;      /* where the context sphere lives in world space */
    --cam:40vw;        /* how far the camera pans right */
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{height:100%}
  body{
    background:var(--ink-night);
    font-family:"Geist",-apple-system,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
    overflow:hidden;
    color:var(--cap-dark);
  }
  .stage{position:fixed;inset:0;overflow:hidden}

  /* ---------------- background layers (screen-fixed) ---------------- */
  .bg{position:absolute;inset:0}
  .bg-night{
    background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 44%, #131a33 0%, var(--ink-night) 60%, #05070f 100%);
  }
  .bg-sky{
    background:linear-gradient(158deg, #5d7cf0 0%, #7a8bf3 26%, #9aa6f6 48%, #c9cdf8 74%, #ecebfb 100%);
    opacity:0;
    animation:fadeIn .08s linear 17.6s both;
  }
  @keyframes fadeIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
  .bg-dots{
    background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.35) 1px, transparent 1.4px);
    background-size:26px 26px;
    opacity:0;
    animation:fadeInDots 1.6s ease 18.35s both;
  }
  @keyframes fadeInDots{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:.22}}

  /* the ground flips in a couple of frames, hidden under the sphere's own bloom */

  /* ================= THE WORLD (camera pans across it) ================= */
  .world{
    position:absolute;top:0;left:0;
    width:170vw;height:100%;
    z-index:2;
    will-change:transform;
    animation:camPan 24s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.2,1) 0s both;
  }
  /* the camera holds on the scattered data, then pans right to the context layer */
  @keyframes camPan{
    0%    {transform:translateX(0)}
    25%   {transform:translateX(0)}                      /* 6.0s  merge begins */
    32.5% {transform:translateX(calc(-1 * var(--cam)))}  /* 7.8s  arrive */
    100% {transform:translateX(calc(-1 * var(--cam)))}
  }

  /* frame A: the scattered enterprise data, one viewport wide */
  .frame-a{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100vw;height:100%;
    animation:retire .01s linear 8.2s forwards;
  }
  /* drop spent layers out of the compositing tree entirely */
  @keyframes retire{to{visibility:hidden}}

  /* ---- source spheres (artwork) ---- */
  /* depth planes: the camera focuses on the middle of the field */
  .d-near{--bl:7px; --ds:1.5;  --o:.85; --dp:2;   z-index:3}
  .d-mid { --bl:0px; --ds:1;    --o:1;   --dp:1;   z-index:2}
  .d-far { --bl:2.5px;--ds:.6;  --o:.72; --dp:.45; z-index:1}

  .dot{
    position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:var(--y);
    width:var(--sz);height:var(--sz);
    background-size:contain;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:center;
    filter:blur(var(--bl,0px));
    scale:var(--ds,1);
    opacity:0;
    animation:
      dotIn 1.1s cubic-bezier(.25,.6,.3,1) var(--d) both,
      dotDrift var(--wt,8s) ease-in-out calc(var(--d) + .3s) infinite,
      dotMerge 1.25s cubic-bezier(.5,.02,.3,1) calc(5.85s + var(--d) / 9) forwards;
  }
  @keyframes dotIn{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(.4)}to{opacity:var(--o,1);transform:scale(1)}}
  @keyframes dotDrift{
    0%  {translate:0 0}
    30% {translate:calc(var(--dx,10px) * var(--dp,1)) calc(var(--dy,-14px) * var(--dp,1))}
    65% {translate:calc(var(--dx,10px) * var(--dp,1) * -.55) calc(var(--dy,-14px) * var(--dp,1) * .7)}
    100%{translate:0 0}
  }
  @keyframes dotMerge{
    0%  {opacity:var(--o,1);transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}
    70% {opacity:.95}
    100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--mx,0px),var(--my,0px)) scale(.08);translate:0px 0px}
  }

  /* ---- colorful UI fragments: the kinds of data an enterprise has ---- */
  .frag{
    position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:var(--y);
    opacity:0;
    filter:blur(var(--bl,0px));
    scale:var(--ds,1);
    animation:
      fragIn 1s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.3,1) var(--d) both,
      fragDrift var(--wt,9s) ease-in-out calc(var(--d) + .4s) infinite,
      fragMerge 1.3s cubic-bezier(.5,.02,.3,1) var(--dm,6.1s) forwards;
  }
  @keyframes fragIn{
    from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px) scale(.9)}
    to  {opacity:var(--o,1);transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}
  }
  @keyframes fragDrift{
    0%{translate:0 0}
    50%{translate:calc(var(--dx,12px) * var(--dp,1)) calc(var(--dy,-14px) * var(--dp,1))}
    100%{translate:0 0}
  }
  @keyframes fragMerge{
    0%  {opacity:var(--o,1);transform:scale(1)}
    68% {opacity:.9}
    100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--mx,0px),var(--my,0px)) scale(.04);translate:0px 0px}
  }

  .f-table{
    width:300px;height:200px;border-radius:14px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(#e2e4eb,#e2e4eb) 0 0/100% 19% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#7fb1f2,#7fb1f2) 8% 40%/20% 11% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#eceef3,#eceef3) 0 46%/100% 4% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#eceef3,#eceef3) 0 73%/100% 4% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#eceef3,#eceef3) 36% 100%/4% 81% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#eceef3,#eceef3) 70% 100%/4% 81% no-repeat,
      #f7f8fa;
  }
  .f-chart{
    width:190px;height:150px;border-radius:14px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(#37c3e8,#37c3e8) left 12% bottom 12%/14% 42% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#5a8df5,#5a8df5) left 38% bottom 12%/14% 62% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#a06bff,#a06bff) left 64% bottom 12%/14% 32% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#e879c8,#e879c8) left 90% bottom 12%/14% 52% no-repeat,
      #141c3e;
  }
  .f-msg{
    width:230px;height:104px;border-radius:20px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 88% 30%, #22a04b 0 7px, transparent 8px),
      linear-gradient(#d4d7df,#d4d7df) 10% 34%/52% 11% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#dcdee5,#dcdee5) 10% 66%/70% 11% no-repeat,
      #f4f5f8;
  }
  .f-cal{
    width:164px;height:164px;border-radius:16px;
    background:linear-gradient(#e35d6a,#e35d6a) 0 0/100% 24% no-repeat, #f4f5f8;
  }
  .f-cal::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;left:12%;right:12%;top:36%;bottom:12%;
    background-image:radial-gradient(#c3c7d2 3.5px, transparent 4px);
    background-size:25% 33%;
  }
  .f-folder{
    width:148px;height:104px;border-radius:12px;
    background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f0b74a 0%, #e39b26 100%);
  }
  .f-folder::before{
    content:"";position:absolute;top:-13px;left:10px;
    width:58px;height:20px;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;background:#e8a938;
  }
  .f-kanban{
    width:240px;height:150px;border-radius:14px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.9),rgba(255,255,255,.9)) 12% 20%/34% 26% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.55),rgba(255,255,255,.55)) 12% 78%/34% 26% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#5aa8f5,#5aa8f5) 88% 20%/34% 26% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.3),rgba(255,255,255,.3)) 88% 78%/34% 26% no-repeat,
      #101740;
  }
  .f-mail{
    width:280px;height:62px;border-radius:12px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 11% 50%, #8b7cf2 0 15px, transparent 16px),
      linear-gradient(#d4d7df,#d4d7df) 62% 34%/44% 13% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#dfe1e8,#dfe1e8) 48% 68%/30% 13% no-repeat,
      #f4f5f8;
  }
  .f-donut{
    width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;
    background:conic-gradient(#2f6bf0 0 40%, #37c3e8 40% 70%, #e879c8 70% 100%);
    -webkit-mask:radial-gradient(circle, transparent 42%, #000 43%);
    mask:radial-gradient(circle, transparent 42%, #000 43%);
  }
  .f-code{
    width:210px;height:150px;border-radius:14px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(#64d3a2,#64d3a2) 12% 18%/40% 8% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#7ea4f2,#7ea4f2) 30% 38%/46% 8% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(#c39df6,#c39df6) 30% 58%/30% 8% no-repeat,
      linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.3),rgba(255,255,255,.3)) 12% 78%/52% 8% no-repeat,
      #0f1633;
  }
  .f-toggle{width:64px;height:34px;border-radius:99px;background:#22a04b}
  .f-toggle::after{
    content:"";position:absolute;right:4px;top:4px;
    width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;
  }
  .f-tag{width:var(--w,72px);height:26px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--c,#8b7cf2)}

  /* ================= THE HUB: context-layer frame ================= */
  .hub{position:absolute;left:var(--hub-x);top:50%;width:0;height:0}

  /* faint orbit paths that give the right-hand frame its own place */
  .orbit-path{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;
    width:var(--r);height:calc(var(--r) * .42);
    margin:calc(var(--r) * -.21) 0 0 calc(var(--r) * -.5);
    border:1px solid rgba(150,180,255,.16);
    border-radius:50%;
    opacity:0;
    animation:
      fadeIn 1.6s ease var(--d) both,
      pathSpin var(--t,26s) linear var(--d) infinite,
      pathOut .45s ease 17.15s forwards,
      retire .01s linear 17.65s forwards;
  }
  @keyframes pathSpin{from{rotate:0deg}to{rotate:360deg}}
  @keyframes pathOut{to{opacity:0}}

  /* the sphere's halo swells to wash the frame, then contracts onto the light ground */
  .bloom{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;z-index:40;pointer-events:none;
    width:100vmax;height:100vmax;margin:-50vmax 0 0 -50vmax;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, #fff 0%, #fff 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.94) 58%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 78%);
    will-change:transform,opacity;
    opacity:0;
    animation:bloom .72s cubic-bezier(.12,.82,.24,1) 17.34s both;
  }
  @keyframes bloom{
    0%   {opacity:0;transform:scale(.08)}
    14%  {opacity:1;transform:scale(.9)}
    30%  {opacity:1;transform:scale(2.3)}  /* 17.56s frame washed - 0.22s to full */
    46%  {opacity:1;transform:scale(2.3)}  /* ground cuts over inside this hold */
    100% {opacity:0;transform:scale(.55)}  /* 18.06s eases open onto the light */
  }

  /* pulse rings */
  .ring{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;
    width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;
    border:1px solid rgba(190,215,255,.4);
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.3);
    opacity:0;
    animation:ringPulse 2s cubic-bezier(.2,.55,.35,1) var(--d) both;
  }
  @keyframes ringPulse{
    0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.3)}
    18%{opacity:.55}
    100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(4.2)}
  }

  /* ---- the context sphere ---- */
  .orb-anchor{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;z-index:10;
    animation:orbMove 24s linear 0s both;
  }
  .orb{
    position:relative;width:340px;height:340px;margin:-170px 0 0 -170px;
    animation:orbBob 7.4s ease-in-out 0s infinite alternate;
  }
  /* two sine oscillations on different axes and periods: a smooth, unrepeating drift */
  @keyframes orbSway{
    from{transform:translateX(-1.5vw)}
    to  {transform:translateX(1.5vw)}
  }
  @keyframes orbBob{
    from{transform:translateY(-1.1vh) scale(1)}
    to  {transform:translateY(1.1vh)  scale(1.045)}
  }
  .orb-sway{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;
    animation:orbSway 11.3s ease-in-out 0s infinite alternate;
  }
  .orb-art{
    position:absolute;inset:0;
    opacity:0;
    animation:
      orbForm 1.1s cubic-bezier(.3,.4,.25,1) 6s forwards,
      orbCharge 1.3s ease-in 6.3s forwards,
      orbPower 1.2s cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.3,1) 15.5s forwards;
  }

5eJEef5gpD743k79Z7pxlIFjGEAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAibAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA) center/contain no-repeat;
    will-change:opacity;
  }
  /* the sphere only exists once the scattered data forms it */
  @keyframes orbForm{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
  @keyframes orbCharge{to{filter:brightness(1.15) saturate(1.05)}}
  @keyframes orbPower{to{filter:brightness(1.35) saturate(1.12)}}
  /* pulsing aura */
  .orb-glow{
    position:absolute;inset:8%;border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle,
      rgba(180,190,255,.4) 0%, rgba(150,165,252,.3) 26%,
      rgba(120,140,250,.18) 48%, rgba(120,140,250,0) 72%);
    opacity:0;
    animation:
      fadeIn .8s ease 6.4s both,
      glowPulse 3.2s ease-in-out 7.4s infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes glowPulse{
    from{transform:scale(1);opacity:.65} to{transform:scale(1.2);opacity:1}
  }
  @keyframes orbMove{
    0%    {transform:translate(0,0)   scale(.34)}
    25%   {transform:translate(0,0)   scale(.34)}  /* 6.0s  forming begins */
    28.3% {transform:translate(0,0)   scale(.72)}  /* 6.8s  grows from data */
    32.5% {transform:translate(0,0)   scale(.9)}   /* 7.8s  camera arrives */
    36.7% {transform:translate(0,1vh) scale(1)}    /* 8.8s */
    50%   {transform:translate(0,1vh) scale(1)}    /* 12.0s orbit begins */
    54.2% {transform:translate(0,1vh) scale(1.035)}/* absorb breaths */
    57.1% {transform:translate(0,1vh) scale(1.005)}
    60%   {transform:translate(0,1vh) scale(1.045)}
    62.9% {transform:translate(0,1vh) scale(1.01)}
    64.6% {transform:translate(0,1vh)     scale(1.06)} /* 15.5s power-up */
    67.1% {transform:translate(0,1.4vh)   scale(1.1)}
    70.4% {transform:translate(.6vw,2vh)  scale(1.04)}
    73.2% {transform:translate(-.5vw,2.5vh) scale(1.18)} /* 17.57s swells into the wash */
    77%   {transform:translate(-.3vw,3.5vh) scale(1.04)} /* 18.5s lands on the light ground */
    84%   {transform:translate(0,5.6vh)     scale(1.13)}
    92%   {transform:translate(.4vw,8.4vh)  scale(1.23)}
    100%  {transform:translate(.9vw,11.4vh) scale(1.34)} /* 24s still moving */
  }

  /* -------- artifact chips: enter, orbit the sphere, spiral in -------- */
  .chips-orbit{
    position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:0;height:0;
    animation:
      orbitSpin 3.6s cubic-bezier(.42,.05,.3,.95) 12s forwards,
      retire .01s linear 15.8s forwards;
  }
  @keyframes orbitSpin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(280deg)}}
  .chip{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:0;height:0}
  .chip-pos{
    transform:translate(var(--ox),var(--oy));
    animation:chipConverge 1.55s cubic-bezier(.55,.05,.5,.9) var(--dc) both;
  }
  @keyframes chipConverge{
    0%  {transform:translate(var(--ox),var(--oy)) scale(1);opacity:1}
    75% {opacity:1}
    100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(.08);opacity:0}
  }
  .chip-rot{animation:counterSpin 3.6s cubic-bezier(.42,.05,.3,.95) 12s forwards}
  @keyframes counterSpin{from{transform:rotate(0deg)}to{transform:rotate(-280deg)}}
  .chip-inner{
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;
    transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
    animation:chipIn .9s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) var(--din) both;
  }
  .tile{
    width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:50%;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 33% 27%, rgba(255,255,255,.9) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 44%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 62% 72%, var(--a2) 0%, var(--a1) 62%, var(--a2) 100%);
    box-shadow:
      0 0 16px 1px color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 60%, transparent),
      0 0 44px 9px color-mix(in srgb, var(--a1) 32%, transparent);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .tile svg{width:28px;height:28px;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2;opacity:.96}
  .chip-label{
    font-size:14px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.015em;color:#dfe6ff;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  @keyframes chipIn{
    from{opacity:0;transform:translate(calc(-50% + var(--fx)),calc(-50% + var(--fy))) scale(.7);filter:blur(8px)}
    to  {opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1);filter:blur(0)}
  }

  /* small accent spheres for the final reveal */
  .bokeh{
    position:absolute;left:var(--x);top:var(--y);
    width:var(--sz);height:var(--sz);border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 38% 32%, var(--c1) 0%, var(--c2) 78%);
    filter:blur(var(--bl,10px));
    opacity:0;
    animation:
      bokehIn 2s ease var(--d) both,
      bokehFloat 16s ease-in-out var(--d) infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes bokehIn{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:var(--o,.8)}}
  @keyframes bokehFloat{from{translate:0 0}to{translate:var(--dx,0px) var(--dy,-26px)}}

  /* ================= CAPTIONS (screen-fixed) ================= */
  .caps{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:20;pointer-events:none}
  .cap{
    position:absolute;left:50%;top:var(--ctop,33%);
    transform:translateX(-50%);
    width:100%;text-align:center;
    font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(19px,2.3vw,30px);letter-spacing:.005em;
    color:var(--cap-dark);
    opacity:0;
    animation:capCycle var(--len) cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.3,1) var(--d) both;
  }
  .cap.big{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.01em;top:20%}
  @keyframes capCycle{
    0%  {opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(14px)}
    16% {opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
    82% {opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
    100%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-8px)}
  }

  /* final lockup */
  .lockup{
    position:absolute;left:50%;top:20%;z-index:20;
    transform:translateX(-50%);text-align:center;color:var(--white);width:100%;
  }
  .lockup .eyebrow{
    font-size:clamp(12px,1vw,14px);font-weight:500;
    letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
    opacity:0;animation:lockIn 1.3s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) 18.3s both;
  }
  .lockup h1{
    margin-top:14px;font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,62px);
    font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.022em;text-wrap:balance;
    text-shadow:0 4px 30px rgba(35,50,140,.35);
    opacity:0;animation:lockIn 1.4s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) 18.65s both;
  }
  .lockup p{
    margin-top:12px;font-size:clamp(15px,1.5vw,20px);font-weight:300;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    opacity:0;animation:lockIn 1.4s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1) 19.05s both;
  }
  @keyframes lockIn{
    from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);filter:blur(6px)}
    to  {opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);filter:blur(0)}
  }

  /* dip to the opening ground so the loop point is invisible */
  .loopout{
    position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;
    background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 44%, #131a33 0%, var(--ink-night) 60%, #05070f 100%);
    opacity:0;
    animation:loopOut .5s ease-in 23.5s both;
  }
  @keyframes loopOut{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}


  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation-duration:.01s !important;animation-delay:0s !important;animation-iteration-count:1 !important}
  }

<body>
<div class="stage" id="stage">

  <div class="bg bg-night"></div>
  <div class="bg bg-sky"></div>
  <div class="bg bg-dots"></div>

  <!-- ============ THE WORLD ============ -->
  <div class="world">

    <!-- frame A: scattered enterprise data -->
    <div class="frame-a">
      <div class="dot d-mid s1"  style="--x:14%;--y:16%;--sz:71px;--d:.35s;--dx:26px;--dy:-20px;--wt:7s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s2"  style="--x:33%;--y:11%;--sz:55px;--d:1.4s;--dx:-20px;--dy:24px;--wt:9s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-near s3"  style="--x:52%;--y:8%; --sz:84px;--d:.6s;--dx:24px;--dy:20px;--wt:8s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s4"  style="--x:76%;--y:10%;--sz:59px;--d:2.1s;--dx:-28px;--dy:-16px;--wt:6.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s5"  style="--x:90%;--y:20%;--sz:67px;--d:1s;--dx:-20px;--dy:26px;--wt:10s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-far s6"  style="--x:8%; --y:44%;--sz:50px;--d:1.75s;--dx:30px;--dy:14px;--wt:7.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-near s7"  style="--x:24%;--y:34%;--sz:80px;--d:.5s;--dx:-18px;--dy:-26px;--wt:8.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-far s8"  style="--x:44%;--y:42%;--sz:42px;--d:2.6s;--dx:22px;--dy:18px;--wt:6s;"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s9"  style="--x:60%;--y:36%;--sz:63px;--d:1.2s;--dx:20px;--dy:-24px;--wt:9.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-far s10" style="--x:74%;--y:48%;--sz:50px;--d:2.9s;--dx:-24px;--dy:-18px;--wt:7s;"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s11" style="--x:88%;--y:52%;--sz:67px;--d:.9s;--dx:-26px;--dy:20px;--wt:8s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s12" style="--x:36%;--y:58%;--sz:55px;--d:2.3s;--dx:18px;--dy:26px;--wt:10s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-near s13" style="--x:56%;--y:62%;--sz:76px;--d:.75s;--dx:-22px;--dy:-20px;--wt:7.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-near s2"  style="--x:18%;--y:72%;--sz:84px;--d:1.6s;--dx:24px;--dy:-22px;--wt:9s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s5"  style="--x:40%;--y:82%;--sz:55px;--d:3.2s;--dx:-20px;--dy:-24px;--wt:6.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s9"  style="--x:63%;--y:78%;--sz:63px;--d:1.1s;--dx:28px;--dy:16px;--wt:8.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-near s12" style="--x:82%;--y:82%;--sz:76px;--d:2s;--dx:-26px;--dy:-16px;--wt:7s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s7"  style="--x:5%; --y:88%;--sz:59px;--d:2.7s;--dx:20px;--dy:-28px;--wt:9.5s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-far s10" style="--x:5%; --y:12%;--sz:46px;--d:3s;--dx:18px;--dy:22px;--wt:6s;"></div>
      <div class="dot d-far s13" style="--x:68%;--y:20%;--sz:50px;--d:3.4s;--dx:-16px;--dy:20px;--wt:7.5s;"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s4"  style="--x:95%;--y:70%;--sz:55px;--d:1.9s;--dx:-22px;--dy:-20px;--wt:8s"></div>
      <div class="dot d-mid s6"  style="--x:28%;--y:90%;--sz:63px;--d:2.45s;--dx:22px;--dy:-18px;--wt:10s"></div>

      <!-- enterprise data fragments -->
      <div class="frag f-folder d-mid"  style="--x:7%;  --y:8%;  --d:3.35s;--dm:6.05s;--dx:14px; --dy:12px"></div>
      <div class="frag f-toggle d-far"  style="--x:27%; --y:15%; --d:4.05s;--dm:6.4s; --dx:-10px;--dy:12px"></div>
      <div class="frag f-msg d-far"     style="--x:52%; --y:5%;  --d:3.5s; --dm:6.15s;--dx:-12px;--dy:14px;"></div>
      <div class="frag f-table d-far"   style="--x:80%; --y:6%;  --d:3.4s; --dm:6.25s;--dx:-16px;--dy:12px;"></div>
      <div class="frag f-donut d-mid"   style="--x:64%; --y:28%; --d:3.9s; --dm:6.35s;--dx:12px; --dy:-12px"></div>
      <div class="frag f-chart d-near"   style="--x:4%;  --y:32%; --d:3.55s;--dm:6.1s; --dx:16px; --dy:-10px"></div>
      <div class="frag f-code d-far"    style="--x:86%; --y:42%; --d:3.7s; --dm:6.3s; --dx:-14px;--dy:-12px;"></div>
      <div class="frag f-mail d-mid"    style="--x:10%; --y:58%; --d:3.65s;--dm:6.2s; --dx:14px; --dy:-14px"></div>
      <div class="frag f-kanban d-near"  style="--x:28%; --y:76%; --d:3.8s; --dm:6.45s;--dx:12px; --dy:-12px;"></div>
      <div class="frag f-cal d-near"     style="--x:76%; --y:66%; --d:3.6s; --dm:6.4s; --dx:-14px;--dy:-12px;"></div>
      <div class="frag f-tag d-mid"     style="--x:43%; --y:27%; --d:4.15s;--dm:6.35s;--dx:10px; --dy:12px;--c:#8b7cf2;--w:76px"></div>
      <div class="frag f-tag d-mid"     style="--x:90%; --y:86%; --d:4.25s;--dm:6.45s;--dx:-12px;--dy:-10px;--c:#27b7a2;--w:60px"></div>
      <div class="frag f-tag d-mid"     style="--x:2%;  --y:86%; --d:4.2s; --dm:6.3s; --dx:12px; --dy:-12px;--c:#e879c8;--w:52px"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- the context-layer frame -->
    <div class="hub">
      <div class="orbit-path" style="--r:760px;--d:6.5s;--t:30s"></div>
      <div class="orbit-path" style="--r:1080px;--d:6.9s;--t:44s"></div>

      <div class="ring" style="--d:6.1s"></div>
      <div class="ring" style="--d:6.6s"></div>
      <div class="ring" style="--d:7.1s"></div>
      <div class="ring" style="--d:15.5s"></div>

      <!-- accent spheres for the final reveal -->
      <div class="bokeh" style="--x:-44vw;--y:-26vh;--sz:8vmin;--c1:#f3b98e;--c2:#e8935c;--d:18.5s;--dx:12px;--dy:-20px"></div>
      <div class="bokeh" style="--x:26vw; --y:22vh; --sz:9vmin;--c1:#f2a6c8;--c2:#e078ad;--d:18.9s;--dx:-14px;--dy:-24px"></div>
      <div class="bokeh" style="--x:-40vw;--y:24vh; --sz:6vmin;--c1:#9cd7f0;--c2:#5aa6dd;--d:19.3s;--dx:16px;--dy:-16px"></div>

      <!-- artifact chips -->
      <div class="chips-orbit">
        <div class="chip">
          <div class="chip-pos" style="--ox:-300px;--oy:-135px;--dc:13s">
            <div class="chip-rot"><div class="chip-inner" style="--din:9.12s;--fx:-130px;--fy:-65px">
              <div class="tile" style="--a1:#3f8dfb;--a2:#8fd0ff"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 19.5V6a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 2.5-2.5H20v16H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 19.5z"/><path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20"/></svg></div>
              <span class="chip-label">Glossary</span>
            </div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chip">
          <div class="chip-pos" style="--ox:-345px;--oy:60px;--dc:13.2s">
            <div class="chip-rot"><div class="chip-inner" style="--din:8.86s;--fx:-150px;--fy:30px">
              <div class="tile" style="--a1:#8b5cf6;--a2:#c9a6ff"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#a855f7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 9v6"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="6" r="3"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="3"/><path d="M18 9a9 9 0 0 1-9 9"/></svg></div>
              <span class="chip-label">Ontology</span>
            </div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chip">
          <div class="chip-pos" style="--ox:-170px;--oy:200px;--dc:13.4s">
            <div class="chip-rot"><div class="chip-inner" style="--din:9.12s;--fx:-75px;--fy:105px">
              <div class="tile" style="--a1:#0ea5a3;--a2:#6ee7d6"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0eb5a3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><ellipse cx="12" cy="5" rx="8" ry="3"/><path d="M4 5v14c0 1.66 3.58 3 8 3s8-1.34 8-3V5"/><path d="M4 12c0 1.66 3.58 3 8 3s8-1.34 8-3"/></svg></div>
              <span class="chip-label">Data binding</span>
            </div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chip">
          <div class="chip-pos" style="--ox:170px;--oy:200px;--dc:13.6s">
            <div class="chip-rot"><div class="chip-inner" style="--din:9.38s;--fx:75px;--fy:105px">
              <div class="tile" style="--a1:#db2777;--a2:#f9a8d4"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#e0356f" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M10 13a5 5 0 0 0 7.54.54l3-3a5 5 0 0 0-7.07-7.07l-1.72 1.71"/><path d="M14 11a5 5 0 0 0-7.54-.54l-3 3a5 5 0 0 0 7.07 7.07l1.71-1.71"/></svg></div>
              <span class="chip-label">Tool binding</span>
            </div></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="chip">

<script>
(function(){
  var HUB_X = 0.90;   // must match --hub-x
  var CYCLE = 24000;  // must match the master timeline length
  var timer;

  // aim every sphere and fragment at the context sphere, in world coordinates
  function aimAtHub(){
    var hx = HUB_X * window.innerWidth;
    var hy = 0.50  * window.innerHeight;
    document.querySelectorAll('.frame-a .dot, .frame-a .frag').forEach(function(el){
      // the depth scale is applied before transform, so divide the travel by it
      var s = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).scale) || 1;
      el.style.setProperty('--mx', ((hx - (el.offsetLeft + el.offsetWidth  / 2)) / s) + 'px');
      el.style.setProperty('--my', ((hy - (el.offsetTop  + el.offsetHeight / 2)) / s) + 'px');
    });
  }

  // run the whole piece again, rescaling the merge vectors in case the window changed
  function restart(){
    aimAtHub();
    document.getAnimations().forEach(function(a){ a.cancel(); a.play(); });
  }

  function scheduleLoop(){
    clearTimeout(timer);
    timer = setTimeout(function(){ restart(); scheduleLoop(); }, CYCLE);
  }

  // pause while the tab is hidden, and pick up cleanly when it comes back
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){
    if (document.hidden) { clearTimeout(timer); }
    else { restart(); scheduleLoop(); }
  });

  window.addEventListener('resize', aimAtHub);
  aimAtHub();
  scheduleLoop();
})();
<\/script>
</body>
</html>

</body></html>

/* The viewport the clip was composed for. */
const CINEMA_W = 1600, CINEMA_H = 900;

function mountCinema(host) {
  const iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
  iframe.title = 'Context preview';
  iframe.srcdoc = CINEMA_HTML;
  host.appendChild(iframe);
  /* One design size, any box — the same trick the panel's own stage
     uses. The iframe renders at 1600×900 and is scaled to whatever it
     is mounted in, so the offer's box, the full-size stage and the
     big view all show the same composition rather than three different
     croppings of it. */
  const fit = () => {
    const k = host.clientWidth / CINEMA_W;
    iframe.style.transform = 'scale(' + k + ')';
  };
  fit();
  new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(host);
  const anims = () => {
    try { return iframe.contentDocument ? iframe.contentDocument.getAnimations() : []; }
    catch (e) { return []; }
  };
  return {
    iframe,
    /* Exposed because a host that was display:none measures 0 and the
       observer only catches up a frame later — a caller that has just
       revealed its box can settle the scale now rather than showing one
       frame of nothing. */
    fit,
    pause() { anims().forEach(a => a.pause()); },
    play()  { anims().forEach(a => a.play()); },
    /* Reloading the document is the only restart that actually works
       here. cancel()-then-play() — what the clip's own replay button
       does to itself — leaves these CSS animations idle rather than
       replaying them: startTime stays null, currentTime stays 0, and
       the clip sits on its first frame. srcdoc is already in memory,
       so this re-parses rather than re-fetches, and it restores the
       document to exactly its initial state including its own replay
       button. */
    restart() {
      iframe.srcdoc = CINEMA_HTML;
    },
    paused() {
      const list = anims();
      return list.length === 0 || list.every(a => a.playState === 'paused');
    }
  };
}

/* Mounted on the offer's first open, not here — an iframe created
   inside a display:none card never gets a rendering opportunity, and
   its animations sit at frame one for good. */
